# Signature Hair Salon

> A barber shop in Newington, Edinburgh, offering men's haircuts, skin fades, beard trims, hot towel shaves and women's short haircuts. Open since 2019.

## Business details
- Address: 7 South Clerk Street, Edinburgh, EH8 9JD, United Kingdom
- Phone: 0131 273 8355
- Hours: Tuesday to Saturday, 9am to 6pm. Closed Sunday and Monday.
- Website: https://avuapq-arch.github.io/signature-hair-salon/
- Payment: cash, credit and debit cards, Apple Pay, Google Pay
- Booking: https://signaturebarber3jpr.setmore.com/book
- Google Maps: https://maps.google.com/?cid=12866875449387239371
- Previously listed as: Signature Barber
- Area: Newington / Southside, a short walk from the University of Edinburgh's central campus

## Good to know
- Book online 24/7, or walk in. Walk-ins are welcome.
- Not 100% happy? We'll fix it free within 5 days.
- We listen first and never cut against the clock.
- Free Wi-Fi.

## Services and prices
Free hot towel with every service except kids' haircuts.
- Men's haircut - £20
- Men's student haircut - £18
- OAP (over 65) haircut - £16
- All-over, clippers only - £13
- Kids haircut (under 10) - £15
- Skin fade - £23
- Zero fade - £21
- Men's long haircut - £30
- Women's short haircut - £25
- Women's student short haircut - £22
- Beard trim and line up - £13
- Italian beard - £23
- Hot shave and hot towel - £23
